desc:
🚧 The game is unfinished and is in PAID EARLY ACCESS. At least you get to try it early. We'll release frequent updates to add more missing features to the game. The game will become free-to-play across all platforms once core features are complete.

💥 Experience some of the best destruction physics on Roblox yet. Unleash your chaos energy and destroy everything on sight.

🏠 From every building, every wall, every structure, even the terrain is fully destructible! Objects are physically simulated. And everything can be burned using fire physics!

🚪 Custom private servers are available inside the game. And can be made discoverable for players.

🎮 Supported devices: Mobile, Tablet, Console, Computer, VR

Basically, "Voxel Destruction Physics 2" but better. If you'd like to support a small indie dev team, pls try our game and share it to everyone 🙏
